title: Lineberger Park
gap: No stated age maximum or weight limits for pool use
blurb: Lineberger Park is an 18.5-acre community park in Gastonia with mature trees, open lawn space, playgrounds, walking trails, picnic shelters, a sprayground, and an outdoor pool with water features. The park includes a Vietnam War Memorial and is bisected by Avon Creek. Facilities include restrooms, water fountains, and parking areas.
extraNote: Swimming pool open Memorial Day through Labor Day; splash pads open Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day
season: Swimming pool open Memorial Day through Labor Day; splash pads open Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day
